name: Teen Engagement Academy
what_you_do: Learn how police work is done from units like SWAT, K-9 and Forensics. You meet once a week for three hours. The academy ends with a graduation at City Council Chambers.
who_can_apply: Local teens ages 13 to 18. Chula Vista residents come first. You must go to the full program. Only 20 teens get in.
duration: About seven weeks, one 3 hour session a week
deadline_text: The 2026 academy met July 29 to Sept 16, 2026, and is closed. The police expect the next one in 2027. Dates are not posted as of Nov 2, 2026.
how_to_apply: Watch the police social media pages. They post when the next one opens. Or email community_relations@chulavistaca.gov to ask.
notes: Closed now. These are the 2026 dates. The 2026 sessions were on Wednesdays from 5 PM to 8 PM at 315 Fourth Ave. The 2026 academy filled up, so apply soon when it opens.
